education.overview.title: Building Skills, Opening Doors
education.overview.body: Just Women develops training and mentorship opportunities for Afghan women and girls. We create space to learn practical media skills, build confidence, and explore storytelling with care. Registration is currently open for some classes — see below.
education.programs.title: Our classes
education.programs.intro: Some classes are open for registration. Others are still in preparation. All registration links go to the organization's official Google Forms.
education.programs.note: All registration goes to the organization's official Google Forms. Submitting a form does not guarantee a seat; we will review registrations and follow up.
education.p1.title: Journalism & Reporting
education.p1.copy: Foundations of accurate, ethical reporting: story development, interviewing, and editorial responsibility.
education.p2.title: GED Preparation
education.p2.copy: Structured preparation for the General Educational Development tests, building academic confidence step by step.
education.p3.title: Health & Mental Health
education.p3.copy: Practical knowledge on physical wellbeing, emotional health, self-care, and where to seek support, approached with dignity and care.
education.p4.title: Human Rights & Women Rights
education.p4.copy: An introduction to fundamental human rights, women's rights, and the frameworks that protect dignity, equality, and participation.
education.p5.title: Documentation
education.p5.copy: Learning to record and preserve Afghan women's stories responsibly — field notes, archives, and careful documentation practices.
education.p6.title: Conference
education.p6.copy: A gathering for learning, dialogue, and exchange — bringing together participants, mentors, and partners.
education.skills.title: Areas of learning
education.skills.s1.title: Journalism & Alternative Education
education.skills.s1.copy: With universities closed, we provide practical media and reporting skills so Afghan women and girls can share their stories and build careers in journalism.
education.skills.s2.title: GED & Academic Foundation
education.skills.s2.copy: Many girls are forced to leave school after the 6th grade. Our GED preparation helps them continue their education, build academic confidence, and open new pathways.
education.skills.s3.title: Human & Women's Rights
education.skills.s3.copy: Understanding fundamental human rights is crucial. This knowledge empowers women and girls to know their rights, advocate for equality, and protect their dignity.
education.skills.s4.title: Health & Mental Wellbeing
education.skills.s4.copy: In these challenging times, mental health is a priority. We provide essential knowledge on self-care, emotional resilience, and where to seek support.
education.skills.s5.title: Documentary & Visual Storytelling
education.skills.s5.copy: Learning to record and preserve stories responsibly. We train women in documentary production so they can eventually create and direct their own films.
education.skills.s6.title: Community, Hope & Motivation
education.skills.s6.copy: Through gatherings and conferences with activists, we create spaces for hope, motivation, and dialogue to inspire the next generation of Afghan women leaders.

education.how.h2.title: Peer Learning
education.how.h2.copy: Shared practice and feedback among participants.

education.how.h4.title: Practical Exercises
education.how.h4.copy: Small assignments that build confidence over time.
